data.english:
There is a small poem named Hariharatāratamya, composed by a learned poet named Rameshwar Pandit. Rameshwar Pandit was a devoted worshipper of Śiva, and therefore it is natural that he focused on the qualities of his chosen deity. In this poem, only those examples are presented which are popularly known among people from the narratives of Viṣṇu and Śiva. Based on these, the poet’s intention is that devotees of Śiva themselves should reflect and understand whether Śiva is superior or Viṣṇu is superior.
With the aim of helping people understand the true nature of Śiva and Viṣṇu, this small poem has been composed, wherein the superiority of Śiva is demonstrated. It is believed that this poem originally contained one hundred verses, because only a few verses are missing from that number. From this, it appears that, like other poets who have composed works of one hundred verses (śataka), this too was intended as a śataka. The Kannada commentator has mentioned at the end that some verses were omitted due to repetition.
As for the present edition, only these many verses were found in the available printed Kannada book, and there are some inconsistencies in places. However, since no other manuscript copy was available for comparison, it has been printed after correcting it as much as possible according to understanding, assuming it to be complete and accurate.
The Marathi translation of this work has been done by Krishnaji Narayan Joshi. This is the first occasion where such a translation from Kannada into Marathi, along with meaning, has been printed. Since no other copy was available apart from one printed Kannada version for verification, if any errors remain, readers are kindly requested to inform so that they may be corrected in the next edition.
If devotees of Śiva make use of this work, the effort put into it will be considered worthwhile.
— Publisher

॥ श्रीः ॥
॥ श्रीसदाशिवमूर्तये नमः ॥
हरिहरतारतम्यप्रारंभः

वृद्धान् श्रुतिस्मृतिपुराणविशेषभाषान् निःशंकबुद्धिकुशलान् प्रणिपत्य नित्यं  ॥ 
अद्वैतमेकमभजं श्रितभेदबुद्धिः पृच्छाम्यहं हरिहरस्थिततारतम्यम् ॥ १ ॥

O venerable elders, noble householders, you are learned in the Vedas, smritis, Purāṇas, and various languages. You are highly skilled in removing doubts that arise in people’s minds. Bowing to you, I ask this: I always worship one deity who is without duality, yet a doubt has arisen in me as to who is greater—Hari or Hara. Therefore, I am unable to understand who among them (Viṣṇu and Śiva) is superior. Kindly tell me who is greatest among them.

एकः समुद्रसलिले वटपत्रशायी त्वन्यः समुद्रशरधिखिपुरप्रभेदे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २ ॥

Among Viṣṇu and Śiva, one (Viṣṇu) lies upon a banyan leaf in the waters of the ocean at the time of pralaya, while the other (Śaṅkara), at the time of destroying Tripurāsura, makes the ocean itself into a bow. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is greater among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको भुजंगशयने स्वपतीह नित्यमन्यो भुजंगकटको नटतहि नित्यं ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) here sleeps daily upon a serpent-bed (Śeṣa), while the other (Śiva), wearing serpents as ornaments, dances here every day. Therefore, O elders, reflect and tell truly—who is greater among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः पुनर्भुवि दधौ नवनीतखंडमन्यो दधौ नवसुधामयचंद्रखंडम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), taking birth on earth in Gokula as Kṛṣṇa, steals pieces of butter, while the other (Śiva) bears upon his head the crescent moon filled with fresh nectar. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

सूनुं चकार चतुराननमेव एकः सुतं चकार चतुराननमेव चान्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) brought forth Brahmā as his son for the purpose of creation, while the other (Śiva) made that same Brahmā serve as a charioteer upon the chariot of the earth when going to slay Tripurāsura. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽस्ति नंदकुटिलव्रजमंदिरेषु त्वन्योऽस्ति मेरुशिखरस्थितकंदरेषु ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) dwells in the houses of Gokula, like the village of Nanda, while the other (Śiva) resides in caves situated on the peaks of Mount Meru. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः सहस्रकमलैर्यमुपार्च्य तस्थावन्यस्तु तैरुपचितः सह मोदते स्म ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), having worshipped the other (Śiva) with a thousand lotuses, remains devoted, while the other (Śiva), being worshipped with those lotuses by Viṣṇu, joyfully accepts it and abides with him. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

गाढांधकारघननीलशरीर एको ज्योत्स्नातिनिर्मलविशुद्धशरीर अन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) has a dark complexion like a dense mass of deep darkness, while the other (Śiva) has a pure, radiant body like bright moonlight. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः कुमारमभजत्सुतरामनंगमन्यः प्रयाति किल शक्तिधरं कुमारम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) has a son named Pradyumna (Manmatha), who is without a physical body, while the other (Śiva) has a son named Kārtikasvāmi, who is very powerful and holds the weapon called śakti in his hand. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

स्त्रीरूपमाप किल पूर्वमभीष्टमेकस्त्वन्यस्तमेवमभजत्पुरुषस्य रत्या ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ १० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) formerly assumed a female form of his own liking, and the other (Śiva) enjoyed that very female form taken by Viṣṇu in his male form. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

मुष्णाति वल्लवगृहे नवनीतमेकस्त्वन्यो ददाति सुधियां परमामृतं तत् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ११ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) steals butter in the houses of the cowherds, while the other (Śiva) grants supreme nectar (liberation) to the wise and virtuous. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः प्रयाति हि सकाम इति प्रसिद्धिमन्यो तथा निहतकाम इति प्रसिद्धिम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ १२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous among people as being influenced by desire (kāma), while the other (Śiva) is famous as the destroyer of Kāma (Manmatha). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य जात इति संततलोकवार्ता नान्यस्य तादृशविदूपितदोषवार्ता ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ १३ ॥

About one (Viṣṇu), there is constant talk among people that he takes birth (his incarnations are well-known), while about the other (Śiva), there is no such commonly spoken report of birth in that manner. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य वाअर्धुषिकजीवनवृत्तिरासीदन्यस्य चापि बहुभाग्यदवृत्तिरासीत् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ १४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) sustains himself, as it were, like one who gives returns proportionate to prior service (like interest on principal), while the other (Śiva) is of a generous nature, granting immense prosperity and grace even for a little devotion. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु दीनगजरक्षणदत्तबुद्धिस्त्वन्यस्तु मत्तगजशिक्षणदत्तबुद्धिः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ १८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) directs his mind toward protecting the helpless elephant seized by a crocodile, while the other (Śiva) is intent on subduing and disciplining the intoxicated elephant-demon Gajasura. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

गोपालकत्वमधिगम्य विभाति चैकस्त्वन्यो वृषाधिपतिनायक इत्यगादि ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ १९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), assuming the role of a cowherd in Gokula, shines in that form, while the other (Śiva) is known as the lord and master of the bull (Nandi). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

ब्रह्माणमाप निजनाभिसरोज एकोऽन्यो ब्रह्मणो नखसुखेन शिरश्चकर्त ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) brought forth Brahmā from the lotus arising from his navel, while the other (Śiva) cut off Brahmā’s head with the tips of his nails. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

विश्वैकदेशवसतिर्मुदमेति चैको विश्वेश्वरोऽयमिति याति हि कीर्तिमन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) dwells in a particular part of the world and is content with that, while the other (Śiva) is famous as the Lord of the entire universe, and his fame continues to grow. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽस्ति केशव इति प्रथितस्तु लोकेऽन्यो व्योमकेश इति याति जगत्प्रसिद्धिम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ २२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous in the world by the name Keśava, while the other (Śiva) is famous in the world by the name Vyomakeśa. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः समक्ष्युदहरन्निजमब्जपूत्यै त्वन्यस्तदा नयनमस्य ददौ च चक्रम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in order to obtain the grace of Śiva, offers a thousand lotuses in worship, and when one lotus is found lacking, he offers his own eye as a lotus. Then the other (Śiva), being pleased with him, grants him that eye and the Sudarśana Chakra. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽस्ति क्षीराब्धिजले निमग्नः कैलासशैलशिखरे खलु वर्ततेऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ २४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) remains immersed in the deep waters of the Kṣīrasamudra, while the other (Śiva) resides at a lofty place on the peak of Mount Kailāsa. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः सुरैरुपगिरं हि तपः चकार तस्मै ददौ सुतमधिक्षिति सांबमन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), along with the other gods, performs penance near a mountain, while the other (Śiva), being pleased with that penance, grants him a son named Sāmba on earth. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु नैल्यमुपयाति शरीरमात्रे त्वन्यस्तु नैल्यमुपयच्छति कंठमात्रे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ २६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) has his entire body of a dark-blue complexion, while the other (Śiva) has only his throat of blue color. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः प्रसिद्धिमिह धेनुवधं विधाय व्याघ्रं निहत्य नितरामितरः प्रसिद्धः ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचित्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) became famous here by slaying the demon Dhenukasura (in the form of a cow/ass), while the other (Śiva) became famous by killing the tiger-demon vyaghrasura. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः सदाष्टमहिषीरुपयाति शीघ्रमन्यो विभर्ति नितरामपि चाष्टमूर्तिम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ २८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is constantly associated with eight principal wives, while the other (Śiva) himself assumes the eightfold form (aṣṭamūrti—earth, water, fire, air, ether, sun, moon, and yajamāna). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः सुवर्णवसनं विदधाति कट्यांमन्यः सुवर्णगिरिचापमधात्कराग्रे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ २९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) wears a golden garment (yellow silk) around his waist, while the other (Śiva) holds in his hand a bow made of the golden mountain (Meru). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको दधौ शिरसि वर्हिणपिच्छमात्रमन्यो मयूरवरवाहनपुत्रदृष्टिः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) places merely a peacock feather upon his head and roams among the cows, while the other (Śiva) casts a gracious glance upon his son Kārtikasvāmi, who rides a splendid peacock. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको दधाति हृदि कौस्तुभरत्नमेकमन्यः सहस्रफणिरत्नमहींद्रहारम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) wears only the Kaustubha gem upon his chest, while the other (Śiva) adorns himself with a garland of the great serpent (Śeṣa), whose thousand hoods bear countless jewels. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

इंद्रानुजत्वात् उपेंद्र इतीड्य एक इंद्रादिभिः सुरगणैः परिपूज्यतेऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ३२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is called Upendra because he is regarded as the younger brother of Indra and thus gains recognition in that way, while the other (Śiva) is worshipped by Indra and all the hosts of gods. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

लक्ष्मीवहनपि च वाञ्छति वित्तमेको भिक्षामटनपि च यच्छति भाग्यमन्यः ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), even though Lakṣmī herself is his consort, still desires wealth, while the other (Śiva), though he wanders for alms, grants immeasurable fortune to his devotees. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः करेण धृतवानिह पाञ्चजन्यमन्यस्तथैव बहुविश्वसृजः कपालम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ३४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) holds in his hand the conch named Pāñcajanya, while the other (Śiva) holds in his hand the skull of Brahmā, the creator of many worlds. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु माधव इति प्रथितः स्वनाम्ना त्वन्यो उमाधव इति प्रथितः स्वनाम्ना ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धा: सत्यम वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ३५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is known by the name Mādhava (the husband of Lakṣmī), while the other (Śiva) is known by the name Umādhava (the husband of Pārvatī). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

वृंदावने चरति गोभिरुपेत्य एकस्त्वन्यो भृशं पितृवने चरतिह भूतैः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) roams in Vṛndāvana along with cows and lives there happily, while the other (Śiva) dwells in the cremation ground, moving about joyfully with spirits and ghosts. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः कदापि मधुमात्रहृतिं चकार त्वन्यो महाविषहृतिं च तथा चकार ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) at one time destroyed only the demon Madhu, while the other (Śiva) consumed the terrible Kālakūṭa poison. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु कैटभवधे निपुणस्तथैवमन्यस्तु मृत्युहनने निपुणो नितान्तम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ३८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) showed skill in slaying the demon Kaiṭabha, while the other (Śiva) is exceedingly skilled in subduing even Death (Yama). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको व्रजेषु कुरुते मृदुवेणुनादमन्यो लयेषु कुरुते विकटाट्टहासम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ३९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) in Vraja produces the sweet sound of the flute, while the other (Śiva), at the time of dissolution, lets out a fierce and terrible laughter. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

पक्षिद्रवाहन इति प्रथितोऽयमेकस्त्वन्यो महोक्षवरवाहन इत्यभाणि ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous as having the bird Garuḍa as his vehicle, while the other (Śiva) is said to have the great bull (Nandi) as his vehicle. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु योनिज इति द्यगमत्प्रसिद्धिमन्यस्त्वजात इति याति जगत्प्रसिद्धिम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ४१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous as being born from a womb, while the other (Śiva) is famous in the world as unborn (not born from a womb). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्त्वनित्य इति सुप्रथितो जगत्यामन्यस्तु नित्य इति शंसति लोकसिद्धिः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः॥ ४२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is regarded in the world as non-eternal (due to taking births), while the other (Śiva) is known as eternal (ever-existing). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको धूलूखलनिबद्ध इति प्रसिद्धस्त्वन्यो विमुक्तभवपाश इति प्रसिद्धः ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous as having been tied to a mortar in childhood by his mother (Yaśodā in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation), while the other (Śiva) is famous as being free from the bonds of worldly existence, having cut asunder all worldly ties. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु पार्थरथवाजिकृतोपचारस्त्वन्यस्तु पार्थसमरप्रणुतप्रभावः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) serves as the charioteer of Arjuna, tending even to the horses of his chariot, while the other (Śiva) is so great that Arjuna himself bows to him on the battlefield and praises his prowess. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको जनार्दन इति प्रकटीकृतोऽयमन्यस्तु शंकर इति स्फुटमीड्यते स्म ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is known by the name Janārdana (one who troubles or agitates people), while the other (Śiva) is clearly praised by the name Śaṅkara (one who bestows auspiciousness and welfare). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

भक्तं बलिं पुनरधःकृतवानिहैको भक्तं कुबेरमधिकश्रियमाधृतोऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) cast down his devotee Bali to the netherworld (Pātāla), while the other (Śiva) bestowed immense wealth upon his devotee Kubera and enhanced his glory. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

व्याधादिनीचहृतनैजवधूक एको व्याधायितोऽपि निगमैरभिराश्रितोऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), after departing to his abode, had his wives taken away by lowly hunters and forest-dwellers when Arjuna was bringing them from Dvārakā to Hastināpura, while the other (Śiva), even when he assumed the form of a hunter (bhilla) to test Arjuna’s devotion, was still praised by the Vedas. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य सेवकजना भृशदग्धगात्रा अन्यस्य सेवकजनाः सविभूतिरेखाः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४८ ॥

The devotees of one (Viṣṇu) burn their bodies by bearing heated marks (taptamudrā) to receive his grace, while the devotees of the other (Śiva) adorn themselves with sacred ash (vibhūti) upon their bodies and appear radiant. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको दधौ सितमृद् तिलकं ललाटे त्वन्यो दधौ हुतवहं तिलकं ललाटे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ४९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) applies a tilaka of white clay (gopīcandana) upon his forehead, while the other (Śiva) bears blazing fire itself as a mark upon his forehead. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको दधाति तुलसीकृतमालिकां हृद्यन्यो दधौ विधातृकपालमालाम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) wears a garland of tulasī beads reaching down his chest, while the other (Śiva) wears a garland of Brahmā’s skulls around his neck. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

गोपालकैः अनुसृतः सुतरामिहैको दिक्पालकैः अनुसृतस्तु दिगंबरः अन्यः ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) lives in the company of cowherds in Gokula, while the other (Śiva), in the form of Digambara, dwells in the company of the guardians of the directions (dikpālas). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको गिलत्यनुदिनं नवनीतमेवमन्यो गिलत्यातिभयंकरकालकूटम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ ५२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) daily eats butter in Gokula at Nanda’s house, while the other (Śiva), at the time of the churning of the ocean, drank the extremely dreadful Kālakūṭa poison to relieve the suffering of all beings. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको मृगाभिलषितो गहने चचार अन्यो मृगं करतलेन वहंश्चचार ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ ५३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, wandered through forests in pursuit of a deer, while the other (Śiva) holds a deer in his hand itself and moves about, without having to chase it through forests. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको दशास्यहृतनैजवधूक आसीदन्यो वधूविलसितार्धशरीर आसीत् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ ५४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, had his wife abducted by Rāvaṇa, while the other (Śiva) keeps his consort as half of his own body (Ardhanārīśvara form) and remains united with her. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु शैलनिचयैः शरधिं वबन्ध अन्यस्तमेव शरधिं त्रिपुरे चकार ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ ५५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, constructed a bridge over the ocean by arranging rows of mountains, while the other (Śiva), at the time of the destruction of Tripura, made that very ocean serve as the base for his arrow. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु मर्कटभटेन ददाह लंकां ह्यन्यः करेण च ददाह पुरत्रयं तत् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः  ॥ ५६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, caused Laṅkā to be burned through the agency of the monkey-warriors, while the other (Śiva) himself burned the three cities (Tripura) with his own hand. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु मर्कटभटैर्निजकार्यकारी अन्यः सुरेन्द्रनिवहैर्निजकार्यकारी ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, accomplished his tasks with the help of monkey warriors like Sugrīva and others, while the other (Śiva) accomplishes his tasks with the assistance of hosts of gods such as Indra. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको विवेश सरयूसलिलांतराले त्वन्यो दधौ त्रिपथगां कणवज्जटायाम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, at the time of leaving his body, entered into the waters of the Sarayū along with the people of Ayodhyā, while the other (Śiva) holds the sacred Gaṅgā (Tripathagā) in his matted locks as if it were a mere drop of water. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः शिवं जगति पूजयति स्म सेतौ रामेश्वरोऽद्य तु जनैः परिदृश्यतेऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ५९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, worshipped Śiva at the time of building the bridge, while the other (Śiva), established and worshipped there by Rāma, is famous as Rāmeśvara and is directly seen by people even today. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु मत्स्यतनुमेत्य गतोऽव्धितोये ह्यन्यस्तु मत्स्यकलितध्वजधक् प्रसिद्धः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६० ॥

One (Viṣṇu), assuming the form of a fish (Matsya incarnation), entered the ocean to slay the demon hidden there, while the other (Śiva) is famous for having burnt Kāma (whose banner bears the fish symbol). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको नृसिंहतनुमेत्य जघान दैत्यमन्यस्तमेव हतवान् शरभावतारे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), assuming the form of Narasiṃha, slew the demon Hiraṇyakaśipu, while the other (Śiva), taking the form of Śarabha, subdued and destroyed that very Narasiṃha. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको वदुः कपट इत्यखिलैरभाणि विद्यागुरुस्त्वपर इत्यखिलैरभाणि ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is spoken of by all as having used deceit in the Vāmana incarnation by assuming the form of a dwarf brahmacārin to trick Bali, while the other (Śiva) is praised by all as the true guru of knowledge (vidyā). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽपि चौर्यहतवानिह ताटकां स्त्रीमन्यो जघान हि मदांधकराक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, slew the female demon Tāṭakā, even though the śāstras prohibit killing a woman, while the other (Śiva) slew the arrogant and intoxicated demon Andhaka. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य रावणवधेऽस्ति दृढासिशक्तिरन्यस्य सर्वबिलयेऽपि हि चास्ति शक्तिः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) possessed strength sufficient to slay Rāvaṇa with his sword, while the other (Śiva) has the power to destroy the entire universe in a single moment. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः प्रसिद्ध इह संप्रति वासुदेवो देवो महानिति सदा च ततः प्रसिद्धः ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is presently famous by the name Vāsudeva, while the other (Śiva) is famous as Mahādeva. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः पदेन शकटं सहसा नुनोद ह्यन्यः पदाङ्गुलिनखेन गिरिं नुनोद ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) once struck and cast away the cart-demon (Śakaṭāsura) with his foot, while the other (Śiva) moved a mountain merely with the nail of his toe. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः पदत्रयमितं त्रिजगच्चकार ह्यन्यः पदाहतिहतं त्रिजगच्चकार ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Vāmana incarnation, measured the three worlds in three steps, covering heaven, earth, and the netherworld, while the other (Śiva), at the time of dissolution, destroyed the entire three worlds with a single kick. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य रूपमधिगच्छति तामसत्वमन्यस्य रूपमधिगच्छति सात्विकत्वम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is said to possess a tāmasic form, while the other (Śiva) is said to possess a pure sāttvic form. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

नीलोऽपि नीलयमुनाजलमग्न एकः शुभ्रोऽपि शुभ्रतरदिव्यधुनीधरोऽन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ६९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), though dark in complexion, was immersed in the dark waters of the Yamunā during the Kāliya episode, while the other (Śiva), though fair in complexion, bears the pure white Gaṅgā upon his head. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.


एकस्य सूनुरपि नेत्रकृशानुदग्धो ह्यन्यस्य वत्स उदितः खलु शाश्वतायुः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) has a son (Pradyumna, the incarnation of Kāma) who was previously burnt by the fire of Śiva’s third eye, while the other (Śiva) has a son (Kārtikasvāmi) who from birth is powerful and endowed with long life. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको वराहतनुमेत्य भुवं विलेख अन्यः भुवं पुरजये स्वरथीं चकार ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), assuming the form of a boar (Varāha), lifted the earth that had been hidden in the ocean by demons, while the other (Śiva) made that very earth into his chariot at the time of burning Tripura. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको चलां निजवधूं न शशाक रोद्धुमन्यश्चकार वनितां स्फुटमर्धगात्रे ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is unable to restrain his restless consort (Lakṣmī) under his control, while the other (Śiva) openly holds his consort (Pārvatī) as half of his own body. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको विभाति नितरां शिखिपिच्छचूडस्त्वन्यो विभाति नितरां नवचन्द्रमौलिः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation, adorns his head with peacock feathers while roaming with cowherds, whereas the other (Śiva) shines by bearing the crescent moon upon his head. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य सूकरजनिः सुलभास्ति हीना अन्यस्य चेच्छरभरूपमतिप्रसिद्धम् ॥ को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) took the form of a boar, which is considered a lower form among animals, while the other (Śiva), in the form of Śarabha, is known to have subdued Narasiṃha, and the Śarabha form is regarded as superior even to the lion. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको विभाति भृशमेकमुखांबुजेन ह्यन्यो विभाति भुवि पंचमुखैः प्रसिद्धेः ॥
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) shines with a single lotus-like face, while the other (Śiva) is famous in the world as shining with five lotus-like faces. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकश्चतुर्भुज इति प्रथितस्त्रिलोक्यामन्यो भृशं दशभुजैः प्रथितो जगत्याम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous in the three worlds as having four arms, while the other (Śiva) is famous in the world as having ten arms. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

पंचायुधमवलशक्तिमुपैति चैकः सर्वायुधप्रबलशक्तिमुपैति चान्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), possessing five weapons (śaṅkha, cakra, gadā, khaḍga, and śārṅga bow), becomes powerful and invincible in battle, while the other (Śiva) attains supreme strength with all kinds of weapons and thus remains invincible against all. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको मुमूर्च्छ गहने च किरातवाणादन्यो ह्यमूर्च्छय दुरुत्रिपुरस्थदैत्यान् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation, while resting in the forest at the end of his life, was struck in the foot by a hunter’s arrow and became unconscious, eventually dying from it; while the other (Śiva) rendered unconscious the mighty demons like Kamalākṣa, Tārakākṣa, and Vidyunmālī who were hidden in Tripura, by his arrows. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु चक्रमधिगम्य ररक्ष लोकांश्चक्रप्रदः पुररिपुः सुरचक्रवर्ती ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ७९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), having obtained the Sudarśana Chakra from Śiva, protects the worlds, while the other (Śiva), the destroyer of Tripura, is the giver of that very chakra and is also the supreme sovereign. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकश्च त्रिपादिति भृशं जगति प्रसिद्धो ह्यन्यस्य सेवकजनोऽपि तथा प्रसिद्धः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८० ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous in the world as Trivikrama (having taken three steps), while even a devotee of the other (Śiva), such as bhṛṅgī, is famous as possessing three legs. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु साधु हयवक्त्र इति प्रसिद्धो ह्यन्यस्य पुत्र इभवक्त इति प्रसिद्धः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८१ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) is famous by the name Hayagrīva (having a horse-like face), while the other (Śiva) has a son known as Gajānana (having an elephant face). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्य भाति चतुरानन एव सूनुरन्यस्य भाति हि षडानन एव सूनुः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८२ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) has as his son Brahmā, who has four faces, while the other (Śiva) has as his son Kārtikeya, who has six faces. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

आदाय वेदमदिशद्विघये पुरैकः अन्यो वेदवाजिषु विधाय तं सूतम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८३ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Matsya incarnation, retrieved the Vedas by slaying the demon Śaṅkhāsura and gave them to Brahmā, while the other (Śiva), during the burning of Tripura, made the Vedas into horses and yoked them to his chariot, appointing Brahmā as the charioteer. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको जघान नरकं सुतरामिहैकमन्यो जघान नरकान् सुतरामनेकान् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८४ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Varāha incarnation, slew the demon Narakāsura, while the other (Śiva) destroys many hells and liberates countless beings from hell. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकस्तु याचकवलिं च पुनर्ययाच अन्यो ददाविह परत्र च सौख्यमेव ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८५ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), becoming a supplicant, repeatedly begged from Bali, while the other (Śiva) grants supreme happiness to his devotees both in this world and the next. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

ग्राहं निहत्य करिराजमरक्षदेको मृत्युं निहत्य मुनिपुत्रमरक्षदन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८६ ॥

One (Viṣṇu) slew the crocodile and protected the king of elephants (Gajendra), while the other (Śiva) subdued Death (Yama) and protected the son of the sage (Mārkaṇḍeya). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकः पपौ स्तनरसं विषतीव्रवेगमन्यः पपौ भुवनभीकरकालकूटम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८७ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation, drank the poison-mixed milk from the breast of the demoness Pūtanā, while the other (Śiva) drank the dreadful Kālakūṭa poison that terrified all the worlds. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

भक्तेन केनचिदबन्धयदाब्धिमेको भक्तेन केनचिदपीतंयदब्धिमन्यः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८८ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Rāma incarnation, had the ocean bridged by his devotee (Nala) with the help of monkeys, while the other (Śiva) had the entire ocean drunk by his devotee (Agastya). Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽवधीद्रिपुगणं च कृतावतारः शत्रून् जयेति च परः समदादनुज्ञाम् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ८९ ॥

One (Viṣṇu), by taking various incarnations, personally slew hosts of enemies, while the other (Śiva) grants permission and blessing to his devotees saying “You shall conquer your enemies,” and by that power, causes their destruction through those devotees. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकोऽर्जुनस्य जयदः खलु सुतभावादन्योऽर्जुनस्य जयदोऽभवदस्त्रदानात् ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ९० ॥

One (Viṣṇu), in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation, granted victory to Arjuna by serving as his charioteer, while the other (Śiva), being pleased with Arjuna’s devotion, bestowed the Pāśupatāstra upon him, by whose power Arjuna attained victory everywhere. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एको व्यधात्तृणभिवाद्रिवरं सुमेरुं गोवर्धनाद्रिमितरस्तु करे दधानः ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ९१ ॥

One (Śiva) lifted the great Mount Meru as if it were a mere blade of grass, while the other (Viṣṇu), in the Kṛṣṇa incarnation, lifted Mount Govardhana with his hand. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

एकं द्विजातिमखिलेषु सुरेषु मध्ये क्षत्रं परं तु परमार्थविदो वदन्ति ॥ 
को वानयोरधिक इत्यनुचिंत्य वृद्धाः सत्यं वदंतु तमिमं वयमाश्रयामः ॥ ९२ ॥

The knowers of the highest truth declare one (Śiva) to be the Brāhmaṇa among all the gods, while they consider the other (Viṣṇu) to be of the Kṣatriya order. Therefore, reflect and tell truly—who is superior among these two? So that we may take refuge in that very one.

अद्वैतमेव भजनीयमतोऽप्रमेयं नित्यं निरंजनमनाकृतिनिर्विकल्पम् ॥ 
सत्यं परात्परमखंडचिदात्मभावमानन्द्यमच्युतमजं तमिहाश्रयामः ॥ ९३ ॥

That alone which is non-dual (advaita) is worthy of worship. Therefore, one should thoroughly reflect upon who that non-dual God is. He is eternal, stainless (free from defects), formless, and without any distinctions; He is truth, supreme beyond the supreme, indivisible, of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, undecaying and unborn. We take refuge in that very Being.

श्रीकांतनामविबुधेंद्रतनूभवेन रामेश्वराध्वरनुचामणिना प्रणीतम् ॥ 
लोके त्विदं हरिहरस्थिततारतम्यं यत्शास्त्रिकं हि शतकं सुधियः पठंतु ॥ ९४ ॥

This work named Harihara-tāratamya, consisting of a hundred verses, has been composed by Rāmeśvara Paṇḍita, the son of the learned scholar Śrīkānta. The wise people of the world should study this and reflect upon who is superior—Viṣṇu or Śiva.

॥ इति हरिहरतारतम्यं समाप्तम् ॥
